name: Smartsheet
one_liner: Work management platform built on sheets, rows and columns, with a REST API, SDKs, webhooks and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal API access tokens (Bearer) or OAuth 2.0 auth code flow. OAuth apps are registered in Developer Tools, which requires registering a user account with Smartsheet and may be denied.
access_notes: API and MCP require Business, Enterprise or Advanced Work Management plan. OAuth Developer Tools registration requires Smartsheet to accept a request; denial is escalated via Customer Success Manager.

buildability.rationale: Documented broad REST API with tokens and OAuth, but a Business-or-higher paid plan is required, and OAuth app registration needs Smartsheet acceptance.

disputes.why: Official API intro states required plan Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management.
Paid plan requirement is the gate; OAuth flow itself is standard.
Official webhooks guide documents sheet and plan-level webhooks.
Scalability page states 300 requests/min per token.
API introduction lists four official SDK repos.
Install page lists regional MCP URLs.

auth.quote: If Smartsheet denies your request, consult with your Customer Success Manager.
A window appears, confirming your newly created app registration and the App client ID and App secret.

access.quote: Required plan: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management

api_surface.quote: The general limit for most API requests is 300 requests per minute per API token.
Smartsheet webhooks send events for plans, sheets, and several sheet components.
Smartsheet provides client libraries that make it easy to call the API from your preferred language.

mcp.quote: Interact with your project data in Smartsheet using the Smartsheet MCP server connected to Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI clients.

buildability.quote: Required plan: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management

identity.quote: The Smartsheet API enables you to programmatically access and manage your organization's Smartsheet resources.
